opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship 2027

amount.raw: A Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000, fully funded including all travel and subsistence, plus a £1,000 financial incentive to part cover replacement labour cost

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Young people aged 18-24, resident in the UK, with a demonstrable interest in the relevant sector (2027 plans award three dairy and three pig scholarships across study groups including Arable, Aquaculture, Beef and Sheep, Horticulture, Pig, Poultry, and Regenerative Agriculture).
opportunities.summary: A fully-funded 30-day study tour aimed at developing young talent in the agriculture industry. Recipients spend a month staying on farms with Nuffield Scholars after an induction day in London, building networks and understanding of the industry, and attend the Nuffield Conference. Applications open in November 2026.
